invariants.name: A merge grant comes only from a person's prompt
Each PR of a grant has a merge word or an un-negated full send of a person's prompt

abstraction.hides: The gh flag table, the gh api method and path rules, the MCP write verbs, the target order, the remote and visibility reads, the hash list format and the session record file.
callersKnow: outboundWrites gives the subject, the target, the texts and the body files of each GitHub text write of a shell step or an MCP call, and no write for each other call.
The outbound handler denies a write with a listed name unless each target is private or internal, and its reason names only the hash prefixes and the targets.
sessionReasons gives a reason for each open PR that the Part of line links or that the session opened from the same root, repo and base, and none with a stacked base or a split instruction.
readDenyList gives none for no copy, the hashes, or a DenyListStop with the path, and loadSessionPrs gives an empty record for a missing or bad file.
abstraction.deletionTest: Without outbound.ts, the handler parses the gh flags and the MCP inputs itself. Without split.ts, duplicate-pr holds the Part of and session rules beside its git and gh reads.

alternatives.name: A manual audit of the public issues
alternatives.rejectedBecause: The next issue can name a client again (ADR 0034).

alternatives.name: A SessionGuards invariant for the outbound rule
alternatives.rejectedBecause: The rule has no state and no order, so a model only restates the law of its control (ADR 0034 D10).

alternatives.name: Ticket keys only for the one-PR rule
alternatives.rejectedBecause: The 3 PRs of the review each linked the first by #N (ADR 0034 D6).

omitted: The model holds no outbound write and no PR create. The controls outbound-text and duplicate-pr-session examine those rules.
The model takes the clause grammar of a prompt as a true observation, so the split instruction has no action of its own, and it gives no grant.

bounds: Attended and unattended sessions, four base authorities, three working-tree authorities, two PRs, two channels, a guard error or none, and prompts of one or two of seven clause classes from four sources.
Each combination of four path facts for one write and an optional commit.
Each set of changes from four change kinds in three places, and 16 git commands with their documented effects.
One repo at the path that the session makes, one record of that path, its settle window, and a repo of another process that appears after the window.
A HEAD whose gates pass or fail under the base profile or an edited profile, one gate run, and one push or commit with or without a hook skip to three targets.

negative.defect: Prompt saves the grant of each prompt, also a framed or machine prompt, so a prompt that no person typed gives a merge grant.

limits: The guards stop agent mistakes and are no security boundary. A name that a variable or an unread file hides keeps its verdict.
A stale or missing state copy turns the outbound check off with no message, so each machine needs one bun run deny sync.
The finite model holds no outbound write and no PR create, and it takes the clause grammar as a true observation.
Exact-head CI, review, Shipping and every ordinary gate stay required.
